figurative_meaning_en: in privacy; in the absence of a third person; in seclusion
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি একলা-একলি এসো, গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কথা আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Come alone-alone; there's something important to discuss.
note: This idiom emphasizes exclusivity in communication, often implying a confidential or personal setting.
